title: Celebrity Sightings and More at NBA Finals Game 1 in San Antonio
text:
The first game of the NBA Finals between the New York Knicks and the San Antonio Spurs drew a host of celebrities to the Frost Bank Center, including Tracy Morgan, Spike Lee, and Tori Kelly. A viral dog named Lilo and the Salesian Sisters also made appearances. Local bars are preparing for a boost in business during the series.
The NBA Finals kicked off with a star-studded affair at the Frost Bank Center in San Antonio, with celebrities from various fields turning up to support their teams.
Actor and comedian Tracy Morgan was spotted in a Knicks shirt, joining fellow actor and filmmaker Spike Lee, who is a prominent Knicks fan. Singer-songwriter Tori Kelly belted out the national anthem before the game. Other notable attendees included actor Jerry O'Connell, known for his roles in 'Stand by Me' and 'Scream 2', and Lilo, the viral 'Air Corgi' who gained fame for predicting the outcome of Western Conference finals games.
The Salesian Sisters were also present, greeting players before the game. Meanwhile, San Antonio bars are gearing up for increased business during the NBA Finals
